items.description: In a statement carried by North Korean state media on Wednesday, Kim Yo Jong — the sister of leader Kim Jong Un — said Pyongyang's "leadership will set up additional military options which are obviously due to Japan's transformation".

items.title: Will Russia start a fresh mobilization drive?
items.description: Russia is preparing a new mobilization campaign to boost troop numbers, Ukrainian officials and independent Russian media outlets report. The Kremlin denies this.

items.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
items.description: Pakistan says an attack on any of the three will amount to an attack against all, amid conflict in the Middle East.
